baseline_comparisons.reason: The passage is dismissed as implementation/non-normative loading guidance. The registered private-reader identity rule says which skill reads references, not to select only the references needed within an invoked workflow.
Routing list is non-normative; skill metadata and private-reader ownership do not express task-selective reference loading.
Fixed scaffolding stages/root files and reference-graph approval are distinct from which procedural documents the assistant reads. The file ledger registers only these two findings.

claims.comparison_reason: All three prior runs omit this task-selective reading obligation as a registered constraint. A workflow instruction can govern assistant behavior despite not prescribing product behavior.
